answer: The most convincing sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions, priced above any epoch reward. Each verifier posts a bond; a proven fraud signal triggers an automatic cipher check of the countersignatures on the ledger, and the stake is burned. Fake identities gain nothing, since every sockpuppet must post its own slashable deposit, so an attacker loses capital faster than rewards accumulate, like a yarrow count where only honest votes survive tallying.
